observations: Photo 0 shows a black electric grill with the brand name 'GEORGE FOREMAN' embossed on the top plate. The grill is open, revealing both the top and bottom ribbed cooking surfaces. It is placed on a tiled surface outdoors, with construction debris visible in the background.

Photo 1 shows the same grill closed, with the power cord and plug visible next to it. The brand name 'GEORGE FOREMAN' is also visible on the top surface. The cord appears intact, with a 3-pin plug. The grill shows some dust and minor wear, and the background is consistent with an outdoor or construction area.

claims.evidence: Both photos show a black electric grill with ribbed plates and a power cord.
No photo shows the grill in operation or any indicator of functionality (e.g., heating, lights). The power cord is visible but not plugged in or tested.

risks.risk: The grill may not be functional despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the grill turned on, heating up, or with indicator lights lit.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged or incompatible with Nigerian outlets.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plug and cord, showing no fraying or damage, and confirming compatibility with Nigerian 230V 50Hz outlets.
risks.if_unproven: priced with reduced value due to potential non-use

risks.risk: The grill may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the grill opening and closing smoothly, and a close-up of the heating elements if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: priced with assumption of possible internal wear

proof_requests: Video or photo of the grill turned on and heating up.
Close-up of the power cord and plug to confirm condition and compatibility.
Video showing the grill opening and closing smoothly.
response.reason: The brand is clearly identified as GEORGE FOREMAN, but the claim of 'working very well' is unverified. The photos do not show the grill in operation, and there is no evidence of functionality. Hidden risks include non-functionality, damaged cord, or internal wear. Proof is needed to confirm working condition before pricing.
